title: ruvnet/RuView: presence and vital signs from Wi-Fi, without a camera
friendlyTitle: RuView guesses who is in a room from Wi-Fi, not from a camera
summary: RuView estimates presence, pose, and vital signs from ordinary Wi-Fi signals, with no camera. It gained about 245 stars on GitHub's daily trending list and has about 103,000 in total.
friendlySummary: RuView reads ordinary Wi-Fi signals to estimate presence, body position, and signs such as breathing. It does not use a camera. It gained about 245 stars today and has about 103,000 in total.
whyItMatters: It can watch a room for presence or breathing without a lens, using Wi-Fi the building already has. It is still sensing people. Use it only where the people in the room know it is on.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can tell you if someone is in a room without filming them. That can help at home. It can also watch people who were not told. Turn it on only with their consent.
